header:
Why Spotify wants
your ears off music

lines.text: About two-thirds of Spotify's music money goes to rights holders.
lines.say: About two-thirds of Spotify's music money goes to rights holders.

lines.text: Spotify says that topped $11 billion in 2025. So why push books and video?
lines.say: Spotify says that topped eleven billion dollars in twenty twenty-five. So why push books and video?

lines.text: Podcasts and audiobooks skip that per-stream label royalty. Spotify strikes its own deals.
lines.say: Podcasts and audiobooks skip that per-stream label royalty. Spotify strikes its own deals for them.

lines.text: US Premium is $12.99 a month and includes 15 hours of audiobooks.
lines.say: US Premium costs twelve ninety-nine a month and includes fifteen hours of audiobooks.

lines.text: And in May 2026, Spotify said over 500 million users had streamed a video podcast.
lines.say: And in May twenty twenty-six, Spotify said over five hundred million users had streamed a video podcast.

lines.text: Meanwhile, operating income went from a €659 million loss in 2022 to €2.2 billion in 2025.
lines.say: Meanwhile, operating income went from a six hundred fifty-nine million euro loss in twenty twenty-two to two point two billion euros in twenty twenty-five.

lines.text: In Q2 2026, gross margin hit a record 33.4%.
lines.say: In the second quarter of twenty twenty-six, gross margin hit a record thirty-three point four percent.

lines.text: Video isn't free, though. Spotify said video costs largely offset Premium margin gains in late 2025.
lines.say: Video isn't free, though. Spotify said video costs largely offset Premium margin gains in late twenty twenty-five.

lines.text: That's the money. Follow for more.
lines.say: That's the money. Follow for more.

post.title: Why Spotify wants you listening to more than music
post.ig:
About two-thirds of Spotify's music money goes to rights holders.
Spotify says it paid the music industry more than $11B in 2025.
Podcasts and audiobooks skip per-stream label royalties; US Premium ($12.99) includes 15 hours of audiobooks a month.
Over 500M users had streamed a video podcast (Spotify, May 2026). Operating income: -EUR 659M in 2022, EUR 2.2B in 2025. Gross margin: record 33.4% in Q2 2026.
Sources: Spotify shareholder decks (SEC 6-K), Spotify Loud & Clear, Spotify newsroom.
News and education, not financial advice.
